title: KIX HUB Instant Interact Fly Walkspeed No Clip Anti AFK etc
features:
Universal Roblox utility that enhances movement, stealth, and visibility across all games. 

Features WalkSpeed with anti-reset, smooth Fly Mode, Noclip, Infinite Jump, Instant Interact, Anti-AFK, and No Fog for clear vision in fog-heavy maps. 

Includes Hybrid Invisible Mode that makes enemies unable to see or target you while still allowing normal movement and actions. 

Fully respawn-safe, lightweight, and equipped with real-time FPS, ping, and runtime stats, plus a global UI toggle ( , key) to hide all custom UIs for cinematic gameplay or recording.

- WalkSpeed (adjustable speed slider)
- Fly (adjustable speed slider)
- Instant Interact
- Infinite Jump
- Anti AFK
- NoClip
- Invicible Character
- No Fog (Bright)
- Auto Clicker (Custom Target)
- Hide UI ( Comma , )
